title: Depth=11 fine bracket
description: Changed DEPTH from 10 to 11 (ASPECT_RATIO/HEAD_DIM/DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE unchanged) to bracket between the confirmed depth=10 winner and the confounded depth=12 loser.
reflection: DEPTH=11 OOMs at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 (78.75/79.18 GB used, tried to allocate 1.5GB more) — even one layer past the depth=10 winner exceeds VRAM at full batch. This means the clean 10/11/12 bracket I proposed isn't reachable without also cutting batch size, which reintroduces the same grad-accum confound that already muddied a1's depth=12 result last round. Not worth a retry with that confound; abandoning rather than spending another run on a comparison we already know is unclean. Takeaway for the group: depth=10 at batch=128 is very close to the VRAM ceiling for this model shape, so the depth axis is effectively maxed out under a batch=128 constraint — future depth increases need either a smaller batch (confounded) or a memory-saving change (e.g. activation checkpointing) to test cleanly. Other axes (LR retuning at the new width, as a0/a2 proposed) are lower-risk this round.
